answer.summary: Investigate linguistic recurrence in arXiv preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 by extracting abstract and introduction text for analysis of conceptual phrases and syntactic motifs without relying on mathematical or citation structures
answer.content: Review full-text abstracts and introductions from preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 to identify repeated conceptual phrases, syntactic patterns, and domain-specific jargon that may indicate emergent thematic continuity in scientific discourse, focusing on frequency and co-occurrence as proxies for memory-like persistence in writing style or topic drift. This investigation directly addresses the prior critique that linguistic patterns alone are insufficient for detecting memory-like behavior, by grounding analysis in explicit textual evidence and avoiding mathematical or citation-based metrics.
